simple.meaning: זְהַר (zᵉhar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “(passively) be admonished.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezra, beginning at Ezra 4:22. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זְהַר (H2095) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: זְהַר (zᵉhar) / H2095 is traced through Ezra 4:22 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2095. zehar [ זְהַר ] verb Pe`al Passive participle plural זְהִירִין Ezra 4:22 be warned ( ᵑ7 Syriac, compare Biblical Hebrew II. [ זָהַר ] Hiph`il warn ).
